notes: Modified cash basis school district; one governmental funds statement (pp5-6, Governmental Funds total column p6); School Nutrition is a governmental special revenue fund so business_type is null. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 12,808,209 (cash basis) and ending_cash = total assets 15,102,759 incl. county treasurer cash and 348,530 investments (investments shown informationally). Taxes 11,882,997 split using fund schedules (General p7, Special Building p13, Bond p16); the printed Taxes line includes homestead, property tax credit and pro-rate motor vehicle, which are recorded as state aid. Local receipts 1,487,967 split by fund column (pp5-6) using the fund schedules (General column includes Depreciation and Employee Benefit, pp7,9,10): interest, activity/student fee receipts, lunch sales, tuition, licenses, donations, other local; the Foundation (Permanent Fund) 176,177 has no schedule and is kept as one item (review). County receipts 77,094 split into 2110 county fines 51,057 (fines and forfeitures) and 2210 ESU 26,037 (p7). Debt Services 1,106,168 split per Bond Fund schedule p16. Transfers 820,000 in and out net to zero. General Fund budget schedule (pp7-8) used for detail instead of combining schedule p18 (function only; not double counted); Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds have own schedules (pp9-10) and are not in the General budget schedule. The General budget schedule's 2600s (2,110,453) and 2650 vehicle acquisition (6,957) lines are kept as printed on p8; together they hide an 800,000 transfer to Depreciation (p18 shows 1,317,410 for building/site and 820,000 transfers out; the report does not say which line holds it), so one contra expenditure line of -800,000 and one other financing line of -800,000 are recorded for the group (review), plus 8000 Transfers 20,000 to Activities. 2650 is recorded as support services / equipment purchases. Schedule expenditure total 14,475,295 includes these transfers. Schedule actual end balance 8,817,778 vs 8,817,777 on statement (rounding, p6). No detail for Permanent Fund (no schedule).
